```yaml
name: Auto‑merge Dependabot security PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  merge-dependabot:
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' && contains(github.event.pull_request.title, '(security)')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Merge Dependabot PR
        uses: peter-evans/merge@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          merge-method: squash
          commit-message: 'Merge ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}'
```
